game_title: Flowchart Lab · Find the larger number
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields, fields of drifting embers: the ember mage must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the ember mage's power beats the shield shown by molten golems.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields: fields of drifting embers
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Read a and b. Display a when a is greater than b; otherwise display b. Test dataset 5: {'a': 10, 'b': 5}; {'a': -5, 'b': -7}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Ember Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about power to power up the ember mage and open the lava bridge.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
